admission_or_exclusion_reason: MG1655 was measured accumulating toward L-aspartate and alpha-methyl-aspartate in two assay formats. The historical cell-accumulation observation includes motor-dependent behaviour, so it selects a candidate but is not itself equivalent to the genomic machinery claim. Reassay a receptor-signal endpoint under the locked protocol.

PAO1 contains generic MCP evidence and an experimentally demonstrated MCP-dependent response to 4-chloroaniline, but neither names L-aspartate sensing. It is a genetic specificity control, not an expected L-aspartate-response-negative control; independently scan its exact assembly for Tar and all required circuit functions.
